name: peer-cast
description: Broadcast a browser tab or screen to anyone over direct peer-to-peer WebRTC. Self-hostable Node.js backend + React PWA + optional Chrome extension.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @peer-cast/shared && npm run build -w @peer-cast/web && npm run build -w @peer-cast/server
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @peer-cast/server & npm run dev -w @peer-cast/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @peer-cast/shared && npm run typecheck -w @peer-cast/server && npm run typecheck -w @peer-cast/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @peer-cast/server && npm run test -w @peer-cast/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test -w @peer-cast/e2e
